name: Yoobure 5-Tier Corner Shelf Stand with LED Lights
description: Yoobure 5-tier tall corner bookshelf with built-in smart LED light strips. Features customizable RGB colors and dynamic lighting modes controllable via app or remote control. Designed with a 90° right angle to fit snugly into any wall corner, saving space while maximizing storage. Elegant reddish-brown wood tiers paired with a steady black steel frame. Excellent condition, includes an extra bottom support foot for maximum stability. Perfect as a bookshelf, plant stand, or ambient room decor. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale! Note: Books, guitar, and other decorative items shown in the photo are not included.
name_zh: Yoobure 5层带LED氛围灯复古风转角置物架
description_zh: Yoobure 5层高款转角书架/置物架，自带内置智能LED炫彩灯带，可通过手机App或遥控器调节多种色彩及动态律动模式。后侧采用90度直角设计，完美贴合墙角，极省空间。红棕色复古木纹板搭配黑色坚固钢架，底部带有额外的支撑脚以防倾倒，稳固安全。非常适合作为书架、绿植架或房间氛围装饰。毕业清仓超低价转让！（照片中的书籍、吉他等仅作展示，非卖品不包含在内）
